title: Austin Approves Tax Assessment Rolls
summary:
• **Tax Roll Approval**: City Council approved supplemental tax assessment rolls for 1900, compiled by the City Assessor and Collector

• **Special Meeting Called**: Mayor convened an emergency council session specifically to address and finalize the city's tax documentation

• **Full Attendance**: Six of seven aldermen were present, ensuring quorum for the important financial decision
